definitions.gloss: concubine; secondary wife (of a lord or ruler)
definitions.explanation: A historical word for a recognized secondary wife of an emperor, shogun or feudal lord, kept so that the house would have an heir. Her children could inherit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{将軍|しょうぐん}→将軍：12386_shougun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{側室|そくしつ}。
⟦{大名|だいみょう}→大名：10378_daimyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{側室|そくしつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{何人|なんにん}→何人：17593_nannin⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。

{正室|せいしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{男|おとこ}の{子|こ}→男の子：02862_otokonoko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|う}まれなかった→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、{側室|そくしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{跡|あと}→跡：02174_ato⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{継|つ}いだ→継ぐ：02292_tsugu⟧。
examples.english: Because the lawful wife bore no son, a son by a concubine became the heir.

notes:

- {正室|せいしつ}: the lawful (principal) wife
- ⟦{愛人|あいじん}→愛人：22539_aijin⟧: a lover or mistress today; {側室|そくしつ} names the old, recognized position
